name: Portfolio assistant
intro: I can help you navigate Aniket's work. I am a lightweight portfolio guide, not Aniket.

answers.What does Aniket do?: Aniket is an AI researcher and product builder working across Generative AI, machine learning, fintech, data analytics, and financial engineering.
answers.What are Aniket's projects?: His featured projects are Laya, a Prompt-Based Business Intelligence System, an osTicket AI/automated ticketing workflow, and an AI Content Generation & Multi-LLM System.
answers.What is Laya?: Laya is an automated SEO intelligence and generation system combining web scraping, SERP ranking analysis, and LLMs. It reduced content creation cycles by 70%.
answers.Where did Aniket work?: He is an Associate Product Manager and previously a Business Analyst at Drivio Technologies, an AI Research Intern at OIST in Okinawa, and a Business Consultant & Analyst at Analy Assist.
answers.What did he research at OIST?: At OIST, he developed GNN algorithms for ecological food webs and energy-flow dynamics, and engineered multi-LLM data pipelines using Gemini, DeepSeek, Anthropic, and OpenAI.
answers.What technologies does he use?: His toolkit includes Generative AI, Transformers, RAG, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, GNNs, AI evaluation, Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas, R, SQL, JavaScript, BI tools, and financial modeling.
